status: generated gameplay estimate — not lab-verified, not live market data
intended_use: 420 one-to-one NFT identities connected to local planting and work simulation; generated gameplay values require playtesting before production release
known_limitations: THC ranges are typical flower windows by lineage family, not per-strain lab data
Popularity is anchored to real data only for the top 30 strains; remainder is ordered by lineage tier as a design choice
Yield is a class-level band (low/medium/high), not measured g/plant
Value tier reflects general market positioning, not a live price feed
93 of 420 rows are legitimately-tagged numbered phenotype variants (is_pheno: true) of proven strains, used to reach a full 420 count without inventing fake cultivars
